import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from collections import defaultdict

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Remove near-duplicates
    keep = set()
    seen = set()
    for fid in feats.ids:
        if fid in seen:
            continue
        keep.add(fid)
        seen.add(fid)
    
    # Build correlation matrix for near-duplicates
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x.T)
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if fid1 not in keep:
            continue
        for j, fid2 in enumerate(feats.ids):
            if i >= j or fid2 not in keep:
                continue
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                # Keep the one with higher mean_y1-mean_y0
                idx1 = feats.column(fid1)
                idx2 = feats.column(fid2)
                if abs(np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx1]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx1])) < \
                   abs(np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, idx2]) - np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, idx2])):
                    keep.remove(fid1)
                else:
                    keep.remove(fid2)
    
    # Select top features by t-statistics
    t_stats = []
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if fid not in keep:
            continue
        y0 = feats.x[feats.y == 0, i]
        y1 = feats.x[feats.y == 1, i]
        t_stat, _ = stats.ttest_ind(y1, y0, equal_var=False)
        t_stats.append((abs(t_stat), fid))
    
    t_stats.sort(reverse=True)
    selected_ids = [fid for _, fid in t_stats[:10]]
    
    # Ensure all selected IDs exist in feats.ids
    valid_selected = [fid for fid in selected_ids if fid in feats.ids]
    
    # Fit logistic regression with L1 penalty to get sparse solution
    if len(valid_selected) == 0:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
        
    X = feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in valid_selected]]
    clf = LogisticRegression(penalty='l1', solver='liblinear', random_state=0)
    clf.fit(X, feats.y)
    
    # Get coefficients
    coefs = clf.coef_[0]
    
    # Select significant features (non-zero coefficients)
    significant = []
    for i, coef in enumerate(coefs):
        if abs(coef) > 1e-5:
            significant.append(valid_selected[i])
    
    # If no significant features, return empty design
    if not significant:
        return Design(drivers=(), columns=(), products=(), loadings={})
    
    # Check for interactions among significant features
    products = []
    for i, fid1 in enumerate(significant):
        for j, fid2 in enumerate(significant[i+1:], i+1):
            # Add interaction term if both features are present
            products.append((fid1, fid2))
    
    # Weighted score based on coefficient magnitudes
    loadings = {}
    for i, fid in enumerate(significant):
        loadings[fid] = abs(coefs[i])
    
    # Drivers are the most significant features by absolute coefficient value
    drivers = tuple(sorted(significant, key=lambda f: -loadings[f]))
    
    # Columns include all selected features
    columns = tuple(valid_selected)
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
